agent_notes: The official Programmes Offered page lists 58 exact programme names across Science, Commerce and Arts; no separate active diploma, certificate or doctoral programme is listed in that catalogue.
The central official catalogue gives programme names but does not explicitly verify duration or eligibility, so those fields are null.
SFS is retained exactly as shown by the official catalogue and represented as self-financing mode; other modes are marked not stated on the official catalogue.

Normal TLS verification first produced the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the confirmed Google/Bing discovery hosts and spcgcajmer.ac.in; no credentials or private data were sent.
